policy_scope: Implemented direct/H0/H1/H2 control flow, not a claim of byte-identical runtime output

instruction_correspondence.typed_unspecified: Additional portable/browser adaptation; not evaluated in native experiment

intentional_port_differences: Native measured H0 reused committed direct and typed-submission receipts. Live controller generates a direct draft unless supplied; H2 computes H0 only when fallback is needed.
Generation/chat rendering, assets and fixed model identity are enforced by the injected runtime adapter.
String question or directPrompt override can preserve an existing browser prompt; these are not the measured native direct instructions.
Browser input/time/output guards may be lower; blocked or cancelled work is preserved and never scored as completed recovery.
CPU controller tests use synthetic adapters. Native accuracy belongs to native-results.json, not to the portable implementation or browser.
Historical normalizer is published as an offline reference only, not silently added to the live browser or used to rewrite new receipts.
Original/direct-only mode can preserve a legacy browser deadline up to 600 seconds; this override is rejected for measured H0/H1/H2 modes.
normalizer_correspondence: The original choice, labels and normalize functions plus their two regex constants are copied unchanged; private grading imports and dataset CLI are omitted.
